newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SHARES UP ON LUCENT VENTURE NEWS.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SHARES UP ON LUCENT VENTURE NEWS.

text.p: Shares in Philips Electronics NV were up 4.50 guilders at 125.50 on Tuesday after news the Dutch electronics giant would merge its consumer communications products business with Lucent Technologies of the U.S.
The shares, which have been firm for the last two days, rose around two guilders after the venture announcement.
A spokeswoman for Philips told Reuters the new venture was expected to be in operational profit by October 1 this year.
